rows.label: Share of the American Red Cross's international spending on the Measles & Rubella Partnership (FY2025)
rows.explainer: Not published. The FY2025 annual report puts disaster support in 32 countries first and the measles visits (3 million households) second; household mobilisation by national societies' volunteers is cheap per household. About a fifth. Read by both the relief and the measles model, so the two always split the $48.8 million in full.
